selection_rule: highest mean macro F1 across LOSO folds, tie-break by lower macro F1 std then higher mean accuracy
hyperparameters: See model object saved in artifacts/models and grouped_cv_* summaries.
notes: Designed to stay lean and interview-defensible.
All temporal operations are subject-local and sorted by timestamp.
Preprocessing and model are packaged in sklearn Pipeline objects for reproducible inference.
confidence_notes: Classification confidence is summarized with ECE and multiclass Brier score.
At confidence threshold 0.80, the model retained 42.7% of rows with retained accuracy 0.924, and abstained rows captured 85.6% of total classification errors.
